value: In src/lib.rs, sorensen_dice removes whitespace and forms duplicate-counted (char,char) bigrams correctly, but uses String::len() for the fewer-than-two guard and Sørensen–Dice denominator. String::len() counts UTF-8 bytes, so non-ASCII inputs can bypass/trigger the guard incorrectly and produce byte-based scores. The repair review computes a_len and b_len with chars().count() after whitespace removal and uses those scalar counts in both places. Equal-input behavior, whitespace removal, duplicate multiplicity, ASCII behavior, and public APIs remain unchanged. Uncertainty: no behavioral/compiler checks have run because discovery must stop at checkpoint.
